# Webinar

## Reducing Grid Strain and Supporting Operational Growth with Fuel Cells

Learn how hydrogen fuel cells can help facilities reduce grid strain, avoid costly upgrades, and
support growth.

[Watch On Demand][71]

# Plug is building the global hydrogen ecosystem.

Plug is driving energy independence forward by building the global hydrogen ecosystem.

[Learn More][72]
[Green hydrogen ecosystem]


## Plug's Louisiana Hydrogen Plant

Take a 3D tour of Plug's hydrogen plant in St. Gabriel, Louisiana.

[View The Tour][73]
[Plug Louisiana hydrogen plant tour]


## Produce and Liquefy Hydrogen

Plug is proud to offer its customers industry-leading electrolyzer products and affordable hydrogen,
which is quickly becoming the molecule of choice for customers both large and small.

[Learn more][74]
[2 TPD electrolyzer]


## Transport Hydrogen

Plug offers trailer solutions to transport hydrogen from production plants to users around the world
daily.

[Learn more][75]
[Transport Hydrogen]


## Store and Handle Hydrogen

Plug offers fully integrated turnkey handling systems with capacities ranging from 60 kg to 8,000 kg
per day as liquid or gas.

[Learn more][76]
[Store and Handle Hydrogen]


## Use Hydrogen

Plug's hydrogen can power a spectrum of applications to help the world safely meet its environmental
goals.

[Learn more][77]
[Forklift fuel cell]

## Plug is building the global hydrogen ecosystem.

Plug is driving energy independence forward by building the global hydrogen ecosystem.

Plug is the only company delivering a complete hydrogen platform, from production and liquefaction
to storage, delivery, and power generation. These are not standalone technologies. They are
integrated, end-to-end solutions designed to make hydrogen work at industrial scale across regions,
industries, and applications.

[MHE forklifts]

Warehouses and distribution centers are seeking alternatives to lead-acid batteries.

**Hydrogen fuel cells are elevating the future of material handling.**

[Learn More][78]
[electrolyzer decarb]

Industrial applications are working to decarbonize their operations.

**Learn how Plug makes this possible.**

[Learn More][79]
[stationary power]

The need for zero emission backup, intermittent, or primary power sources is becoming more critical.

**Hydrogen is making it happen.**

[Learn More][80]

## Plug is Powering the Hydrogen Revolution

Plug is powering the hydrogen revolution. Many organizations want clean energy solutions to help
them solve tough productivity and operational challenges. Hydrogen can be used in many different
applications. Plug is leading the way. Plug’s customer demand for hydrogen has grown by 10 times in
five years — nearly a 200% annual growth rate. Our clean energy solutions are solving problems for a
wide range of customers worldwide.

## Our World-Changing Customers

[View more][81]

# SFC Energy AG

**Clean energy for generations.** Anytime, anywhere.

Stationary and mobile fuel cell solutions

[Product Overview][80] [Technology][81]

## **Resilient Energy Solutions**
## EFOY Fuel Cell vs. Generator

Compared to conventional generators, fuel cell technology provides a cleaner, quieter, and more
resilient energy solution. Designed for continuous, autonomous operation, fuel cells deliver
reliable off-grid power without moving parts, frequent maintenance, or high noise levels — making
them the smarter alternative for mission-critical applications.

## This is how the **SFC Fuel Cell** works

**Air**

**EFOY Fuel Cartridge**

**Waste heat + Water vapour + CO2**

**Power**

[more about our technology][82]

## Mobile and off-grid power generation and distribution
## **in all markets**

SFC Energy is a global leader in mobile and off-grid power solutions for the Clean Energy &
Mobility, Public Security, Oil & Gas, and other Industrial markets.

### **Clean Energy**
### Fuel cells and Integrated Solutions

Reliability, self-sufficiency and comfort: SFC Energy's environmentally friendly, silent fuel cell
solutions ensure uninterrupted power supply, whether on board government and recreational vehicles
or in other mobile or stationary off-grid applications.

[Learn more][83]

### **Clean Power Management**
### Power Products & Electronics

Discover our high-quality custom power supply solutions and specialty coils for highly sensitive,
demanding industrial applications as well as variable frequency drive (VFD) systems as intelligent
drive solutions to save energy and extend motor life.

[Learn more][84]
